tasks.analysis: What are some foundational skills for academic success? Critical thinking allows students to approach problems systematically, analyze information, and make connections between ideas. Also important are soft skills like time management and social skills. Time management is helpful for balancing studies, extracurricular activities, and personal life in an efficient manner.
